scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and independently constructed finite checker, with finite tests explicitly separated from infinite claims. Literature comparison includes a directly relevant inaccessible source as residual risk.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for the unweighted adjacency walk between endpoints of the same peripheral edge in friendship graphs. Infinity-time supremum need not be attained when \(\sqrt{8m+1}\) is irrational. Results are leading-order asymptotics, not exact finite-m optimizers; full text of a relevant 2023 Dutch-windmill thesis was inaccessible.
title: Three arithmetic regimes for optimal quantum transfer on friendship graphs
